sources.used_for: 2D product-projection density cap <=2; twisted Fourier Lp bound; geometric Brascamp-Lieb
designated partner Theorem A/B and actual null-side inequality application

new_result.statement_short: For rank-two cross M=U diag(s1,s2)V^T and an original-coordinate diagonal J side, if the normalized right-row directions admit weights 0<omega_j<=1/2 with sum omega_j e_j e_j^T=I2, then the full form has continuous density bounded by 4 sqrt(2) (s1 s2)^(-1/2) product (omega_j/c_j)^(omega_j/4), with arbitrary other blocks/couplings.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: For A_ext=[[0,M,G],[M^T,0,H],[G^T,H^T,S]] with M=CE^T from two balanced m x 2 Parseval banks, ||p_(X^T A_ext X)||_infinity <= 2 sqrt(pi) for arbitrary outside G,H,S; the full matrix has at least four eigenvalues of modulus >=1 by principal-submatrix interlacing.

strict_extension_example: Right singular leverages (3/5,2/5,1/2,1/2) fail the partner canonical gate, but omega=(1/2,1/2,1/2,1/2) gives a target-valid six-dimensional core with density <=2 sqrt(2)(25/24)^(1/8)<2.843, stable under arbitrary outside cross couplings.
next_step: On the near-coloop superdiffuse survivor, prove a capped isotropic decomposition for one useful diagonal-side rank-two bank cut, or convert failure into a bounded heavy doubled-angle source cluster and pay its non-diagonal same-side curvature source-first.
